verse.text: Direct your children onto the right path, and when they are older, they will not leave it.

video.title: Are You Raising Your Child God's Way? – Proverbs 22:6

reflection: Every day you point your kids toward what's right — how you handle money, anger, honesty, and prayer — you're laying down a path they'll walk for the rest of their lives. You won't do it perfectly, but consistency beats perfection; small, repeated moments of guidance shape a kid far more than one big speech ever could. Show up today, even in the ordinary stuff, and trust that it's building something lasting.
